name: Hold-Key Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd.
summary: Hold-Key Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise that specializes in the manufacturing, import, and distribution of diverse cable products within the domestic market. Its extensive portfolio encompasses various cable types, including XLPE power, electric, aluminum, rubber, communication, fiber optic, EV charging, and LAN cables. Beyond cabling, they also supply essential cable accessories such as terminations and joints, as well as power conversion components like transformers and capacitors. Further offerings include USB connectivity solutions, networking systems, and specialized heat-resistant and solar wires. In addition to its core cable operations, the company also engages in property leasing activities and serves international markets through product exports. Established in 1989, Hold-Key maintains its corporate headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
